title: DLR EOC STAC API Vocabulary
description: Domain vocabulary for the DLR Earth Observation Center STAC API, covering key terms used in Earth observation data access via the OGC/STAC ecosystem.

terms.definition: SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog — a specification for describing geospatial information enabling search, discovery, and access to Earth observation data.
A logical grouping of Earth observation data items sharing common metadata, spatial/temporal extents, and licensing. Examples: TDM90 (TanDEM-X DEM), S5P_TROPOMI_L2_NO2.
A GeoJSON Feature representing a single Earth observation scene or product tile with STAC metadata including datetime, geometry, assets, and provenance.
A link to an actual data file or resource associated with a STAC Item (e.g., image files, metadata XMLs, thumbnails), described by href, type, title, and roles.
Earth Observation Center — the DLR department that operates the geoservice.dlr.de platform, managing satellite data from missions including TanDEM-X, TerraSAR-X, EnMAP, DESIS, and Sentinel.
Twin Radar in Tandem — a DLR satellite mission producing a global, high-resolution digital elevation model (TDM90, 90m; TDM30, 30m) via bistatic SAR interferometry.
A German SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) satellite operated by DLR providing high-resolution X-band radar imagery for scientific and commercial applications.
Environmental Mapping and Analysis Program — a DLR hyperspectral satellite providing 230-band spectral data for ecosystem and environmental monitoring.
DLR Earth Sensing Imaging Spectrometer — a hyperspectral sensor aboard the ISS providing 235 spectral bands from 400-1000 nm.
TROPOspheric Monitoring Instrument — the main instrument on Sentinel-5P, providing atmospheric trace gas measurements including NO2, O3, SO2, CH4, and CO.
OGC Web Map Service — a standard protocol for serving georeferenced map images over the internet, used by DLR for visualizing EO products.
OGC Web Coverage Service — a standard for accessing raw geospatial coverage data (raster grids) in scientific formats, used by DLR for programmatic data download.
OGC Web Map Tile Service — a tile-based map serving standard optimized for web performance and caching.
Bounding box — a rectangular spatial filter defined as [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) coordinates used to limit search results to a geographic area.
ISO 8601 date-time string or interval (e.g., '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z/2023-12-31T23:59:59Z') used to filter STAC items by acquisition time.
Common Query Language 2 — an OGC standard for filter expressions enabling complex attribute-based filtering of geospatial features, supported by the DLR STAC API via /filter-capabilities.
The set of item properties that can be used in filter expressions for a given collection, described via the /queryables endpoint.
The set of item properties by which search results can be sorted, described via the /sortables endpoint, supporting asc/desc direction.
Ground Sample Distance — the spatial resolution of a satellite image in meters, representing the size of one pixel on the ground.
Digital Elevation Model — a 3D representation of terrain elevation values stored as a raster grid; DLR produces the TanDEM-X DEM at 12m, 30m, and 90m resolutions.
A DLR-derived global dataset mapping human settlements at 10m resolution, available via the EOC Land WMS and STAC catalog.
DLR's web portal for Earth observation data access (https://eoweb.dlr.de/egp/), supporting browse, order, and WCS download for registered users.
